name: Trae Agent (ByteDance)
disclaimer: Written from the documented interface, not verified against an install. Flags drift; correct and open a PR.

options.trust_none_why: No documented read-only or tool-less mode. Until one exists this adapter is ineligible for the reviewer role: a reviewer that can write is not a reviewer, and guessing a flag would be worse than refusing.
options.trust_all_why: Tools are on by default; there is no flag to widen or narrow them.

roles.reviewer: ineligible: cannot be run without tools
roles.architect: untested: no resume, so a woken architect would start without its history

model_selection.why: Unlike harnesses that take a single model id, this one names the provider separately, so a role binding here carries both and the family is read from the provider rather than inferred from the model string.

resume.why: No documented resume or continue; each run starts fresh.
